title: The exact BSD formula at low Selmer corank
exact_target: For every elliptic curve E over Q, if its p-primary full Selmer group has $Z_p$ corank zero or one for at least one prime p, must analytic rank equal Mordell-Weil rank, must the entire Tate-Shafarevich group be finite, and must the leading coefficient of L(E,s) at $s=1$ equal the BSD expression using the Neron period, regulator, full Sha order, finite Tamagawa factors and rational torsion order?
